sections.content: How many people stayed in Gillingham (North Dorset) after gaining qualifications?

Gillingham (North Dorset) is a small town in the South West. Gillingham (North Dorset) does not have its own university.

Gillingham (North Dorset) has lower levels of deprivation.

Overall, Gillingham (North Dorset) ended up with:

  • fewer non-graduates with advanced qualifications than it produced
Note: all towns and cities in this analysis are defined based on population size only. This means that some cities are classed as towns because of their population.

Let's explore this further

There were 535 state-school pupils from Gillingham (North Dorset) who sat their GCSEs between the 2007 to 2008 and the 2010 to 2011 school years.

Of these, 150 (28%) went on to gain degree-level qualifications (level 6+ as defined by The Office of Qualifications and Examinations Regulation, or Ofqual ). We will call these people graduates.

Another 175 (33%) went on to gain other advanced post-16 qualifications, such as A-Levels, a foundation degree or higher apprenticeship (levels 3-5 as defined by Ofqual). In this tool, we will refer to these non-graduates with advanced qualifications as “qualified non-graduates", for brevity.

The charts below compare Gillingham (North Dorset) to other English towns and cities using three measures:

  • what proportion of Gillingham (North Dorset)'s pupils became graduates or qualified non-graduates by the 2017 to 2018 academic year
  • of those graduates and qualified non-graduates, the percentages that lived in Gillingham (North Dorset) in the 2018 to 2019 academic year
  • how many graduates and qualified non-graduates from elsewhere came to live there by 2018 to 2019, relative to the number who sat their GCSEs there

In some towns, some of this information may not be available because of small sample sizes.
The size and deprivation level of a town, as well as the qualification levels of older residents, were all related to students' educational attainment. Read our previous analysis.

Where did those who left Gillingham (North Dorset) move to?

Of Gillingham (North Dorset)'s graduates, 85 were living elsewhere in 2018/19.

Of Gillingham (North Dorset)'s qualified (level 3+) non-graduates, 85 were living elsewhere in 2018/19.

However, 25 of those qualified non-graduates (29%) were living fairly locally, in the Blandford Forum and Gillingham travel to work area (TTWA).

Of those in Gillingham (North Dorset)'s GCSE cohort:

  • 50 graduates left the South West

In 2018 to 2019, 38% of qualified non-graduates living in Gillingham (North Dorset) had moved there from elsewhere

In the 2018 to 2019 academic year, there were 145 qualified (level 3+) non-graduates from our cohort living in Gillingham (North Dorset), compared with the 175 qualified non-graduates who had lived there when they sat their GCSEs.

In the 2018 to 2019 academic year, 62% of qualified (level 3+) non-graduates in Gillingham (North Dorset) had also lived there when they sat their GCSEs, while 38% had moved there from elsewhere.
